title: Phase E brief — three small windows
_note: Nothing is built yet: every picture is today's app on master. 'What changed' reads as 'what I propose to change'. The audit's fourth Phase E item — the word 'undefined' printed in the local-models list — no longer happens; the list was rewritten since, so there is nothing left to fix and it is not in this brief.

steps.headline: Three of the thirteen shortcuts are cut off the bottom of this window, and it does not scroll — so you can never read them.
steps.changed: Widen the window from 340 to 420 pixels, line the labels and keys up in two columns, and let the list scroll so all thirteen are reachable.
steps.measured: 340 px wide; 4 of the 10 visible labels wrap to two lines; 3 of 13 rows unreachable at any window size
steps.notice: Every shortcut fits on one line, and the three hidden ones appear: open the skill drawer, close a menu, and move between the permission buttons.
steps.risk: The window covers a little more of the screen behind it, and a future shortcut with a very long name could still wrap.

steps.headline: Session names wrap onto two and three lines in this narrow menu, so fewer sessions fit and the last row is sliced in half.
steps.changed: Widen the menu to about 448 pixels and keep every session on one line, shortened with “…” and shown in full when you rest the pointer on it.
steps.measured: 288 px wide; 6 of 10 names wrap; the tallest row is 70 px against 42 px for a one-line row
steps.notice: Around nine sessions fit where six did, rows stop varying in height, and the project name sits clear of the name instead of jammed beside it.
steps.risk: The menu covers more of the window behind it, and a long name is hidden behind “…” until you hover it.

steps.headline: This window scrolls, but the only hint is a slight dimming at the bottom edge — it ends mid-section at “Local models” with no scroll bar.
steps.changed: Give a window that has more content below it a thin scroll bar down its right edge, on top of the soft dimming that is already there.
steps.measured: 588 px of window holding about 900 px of content; the bottom edge dims text by about a quarter; no scroll bar in any of the six themes
steps.notice: You can see at a glance that there is more below and how far down you are. This reaches every scrolling panel in the app, not only this one — Settings sections, menus, the sync log.
steps.risk: It is a wide change for one complaint: a bar appears in many places at once, and on the picture-backed themes it is one more grey line over the artwork.

steps.headline: One window, four button shapes: a filled pill, small outlined chips, a red outlined one, and a full-width outlined “Add provider”.
steps.changed: Make “Add provider” a small button like “Add key” and “Test”, leaving “Connect to OpenRouter” as the only filled button in the window.
steps.measured: 4 button shapes in one window; “Add provider” is 386 px wide against 60–80 px for the rest
steps.notice: “Add provider” stops reading as the most important thing on the page. Nothing changes about what any button does.
steps.risk: A smaller “Add provider” is easier to miss when you are hunting for it. This one is taste, not a defect — today's layout is not broken.
